details: The crypto market has experienced a broad downturn, with Bitcoin briefly dropping below $62,000 and reaching its weakest price since October 2024. The CoinDesk 20 index fell 4.8%, with all twenty assets trading lower, and Bitcoin leading the decline with a 2.8% drop. Other major cryptocurrencies, including Binance Coin, ICP, and NEAR, also saw significant losses, signaling increased selling pressure and cautious investor sentiment. This comes amid extended losses for BTC, with some analysts noting a "$1.2 billion options wall at $60,000" and a repricing of Fed rate-cut expectations.
title: Bitcoin and Broader Crypto Market Face Significant Downturn

details: Zcash (ZEC) experienced a sharp decline, plummeting approximately 40-44%, after Shielded Labs disclosed a major bug that had gone undetected for four years. Despite the significant price crash, Zcash treasury company Cypherpunk has affirmed its commitment to accumulating 5% of the ZEC supply, attempting to counter market "FUD" (fear, uncertainty, and doubt).
title: Zcash Plummets Following Revelation of Long-Undetected Bug

details: Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, in partnership with Galaxy Digital, is now allowing eligible clients to lend Bitcoin and other digital assets. This initiative facilitates in-kind conversions into spot crypto Exchange Traded Product (ETP) shares.
title: Morgan Stanley Enables Clients to Lend Crypto for Spot ETF Conversions

details: New crypto tax legislation has been circulated in the U.S. House of Representatives, ahead of a scheduled hearing by the House Ways and Means Committee next week. This signals a continued push for regulatory clarity regarding digital assets.
title: Upcoming Crypto Tax Legislation Circulated in U.S. House

details: Terry Duffy, CEO of CME Group, has expressed concerns regarding new perpetual futures products in the cryptocurrency market, stating they could be "a disaster waiting to happen." This highlights ongoing regulatory and systemic risk discussions around certain crypto derivatives.
title: CME CEO Warns New Perpetual Futures Could Be a 'Disaster'

details: Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have ended prolonged periods of net outflows, with Bitcoin ETFs breaking a 13-day streak and Ethereum ETFs ending a 17-day streak. Analysts suggest this shift indicates traders are rotating into equity perpetuals ahead of non-farm payrolls (NFP) data.
title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs Break Long Outflow Streaks

details: Bitcoin fell below $62,000 on June 5, 2026, following stronger-than-expected U.S. jobs data, which has increased expectations for potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes. This broader market pressure was exacerbated by a significant selloff in Zcash, pushing Bitcoin to its lowest price since early February. Ethereum also experienced a sharp decline during this period.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $62K Amid Strong US Jobs Data and Zcash Bug

details: Zcash (ZEC) plummeted by over 40% on June 5, 2026, after a critical counterfeiting vulnerability was disclosed in its Orchard shielded pool. The bug, which remained undetected for four years, could have theoretically allowed for the unlimited creation of counterfeit ZEC tokens. While an emergency fix has been deployed and the Zcash Foundation stated there's no evidence of exploitation, the news triggered significant market panic.
title: Zcash Plummets 40% After Four-Year-Old Counterfeiting Bug Disclosure

details: Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, in collaboration with Galaxy Digital, has launched a new referral arrangement. This program enables eligible clients to lend cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana to Galaxy in exchange for shares in spot crypto Exchange Traded Products (ETPs), including the Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust. This initiative aims to streamline the process and has lowered transaction minimums for referred clients.
title: Morgan Stanley Clients Can Now Lend Crypto for Spot ETP Shares

details: The U.S. House Ways and Means Committee has circulated seven discussion drafts of bills addressing digital asset taxation. These proposals aim to clarify tax treatment for stablecoins, staking rewards, mining income, and various crypto transactions. A hearing is scheduled for next week to discuss and refine these legislative drafts.
title: U.S. House Circulates Crypto Tax Bills Ahead of Committee Hearing

details: Terry Duffy, CEO of CME Group, has strongly criticized the recent approval of cryptocurrency perpetual futures in the U.S., labeling them "a disaster waiting to happen." He warned that these highly leveraged products, which can offer up to 50x leverage, pose significant risks to retail investors and could potentially destabilize financial markets, citing concerns over automatic liquidations and opaque funding rate costs.
title: CME CEO Terry Duffy Labels New Crypto Perpetual Futures 'Disaster Waiting to Happen'

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin and Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have experienced net inflows, breaking prolonged periods of investor withdrawals. Bitcoin ETFs ended a 13-day outflow streak with $3.05 million in inflows, while Ethereum ETFs halted a 17-day outflow period, attracting $19.30 million, primarily driven by BlackRock's ETHA fund. This development suggests a potential shift in investor sentiment following weeks of continuous redemptions.
title: Bitcoin, Ethereum Spot ETFs End Lengthy Outflow Streaks
